services.title: Make AI coding actually deliver
services.subtitle: Hands-on services for teams adopting AI coding: turn AI-assisted development into real productivity, then turn AI-generated code into a trustworthy asset. Every engagement starts with a written diagnosis — verify first, invest after.
services.aDesc: Assess how your team actually uses Cursor, Claude Code and agent workflows, surface the efficiency leaks and risks, and deliver an actionable optimization plan.
services.aPrice: Diagnostic report from $500–2,000, depending on team size
services.bDesc: Audit the AI/agent-generated parts of your codebase, deliver a prioritized risk report, and remediate on request. Especially relevant for teams facing disclosure obligations (e.g. CRA vulnerability reporting duties).
services.bPrice: Audit report from $3K, depending on codebase size
services.why1Body: Every position on AI coding and agent security comes from direct hands-on work, documented bilingually on hao430.cn (including “Your AI Agent Is Running as Root”).
services.why2Body: References are independently verified (JetBrains, Stack Overflow, industry incidents); unverifiable numbers are not repeated, and hype is not recycled.
services.why3Body: A free 30-minute diagnosis comes first; the written proposal and fixed quote follow. No hidden fees, no lock-in.
services.process1Body: Online call to understand your situation, goals and pain points. You decide whether to continue.
services.process2Body: A written proposal with a fixed quote within 48 hours of the diagnosis. No later upsells.
services.process3Body: Deliverables are produced milestone by milestone, verifiable at each step.
services.ctaBody: One conversation gets you the biggest AI-coding waste and the most urgent risks in your team. Replies usually within 24 hours.
services.fineprint: Diagnosis is free, no sales pitch, no lock-in. Transparent pricing: audit from $3K, workflow diagnosis $500–2,000, remediation from $20K.
services.aPoints1: Team AI-coding capability audit (where you are vs. what's achievable)
services.aPoints2: Workflow and engineering standards design (prompt assets, review loops, agent boundaries)
services.aPoints3: Rollout support: a staged path from pilot team to org-wide adoption
services.bPoints1: AI-code footprint detection and risk-surface scanning (supply chain, permissions, leaked secrets)
services.bPoints2: Written risk report: itemized severity ratings + fix guidance, ready for compliance workflows
services.bPoints3: Optional remediation delivery: from $20K, scoped per engagement, quoted up front

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how hao430.cn ("this site") collects, uses and protects visitor information. By accessing this site, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.sec1Body:
This site is a static personal website. It has no user accounts and no registration.
We do not actively collect personally identifiable information such as your name, email or phone number, unless you contact us directly by email.
When you visit, the server and content delivery network (CDN) may keep basic access logs (e.g. IP address, browser type, time of access) to ensure security and measure traffic.
privacy.sec2Body:
This site uses cookies and browser local storage to provide core features:
- Language preference: your chosen interface language is stored in localStorage;
- Third-party advertising and analytics services (see Section 3) may set their own cookies.
You can disable or clear cookies in your browser settings, but some features may be affected.
privacy.sec3Body:
This site displays ads via Google AdSense. Google and its partners, as third-party vendors, may use cookies (such as the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads on this site and across the web.
Google uses information about your visits to this and other sites to serve personalized ads. You can opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com), or learn more at www.aboutads.info.
privacy.sec4Body:
We use collected information to improve site content and experience, measure traffic, keep the site secure, and sustain operations through advertising.
We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
privacy.sec5Body:
Under applicable law (including the EU GDPR and China's Personal Information Protection Law), you have the right to access, correct or delete personal information related to this site.
Since this site does not collect user account data, if you need to inquire about or delete any potentially stored information, please contact us via the details at the end of this page.
privacy.sec6Body: Articles on this site may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices; we encourage you to review their privacy policies when you visit them.
privacy.sec7Body: This site is intended for the general public and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.sec8Body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date on this page. Material changes will be highlighted prominently on this site.
